subject: Proposed Tree Preservation and Committee Ordinances
overview: The committee reviewed three draft ordinances intended to expand the city's tree canopy by establishing a Tree Committee, updating public shade tree regulations, and creating zoning rules for trees on private property. The body referred the proposals to relevant city departments and a working group to assess staffing costs and simplify regulatory language before further action.

items.title: Tree Committee and Public Tree Ordinances
items.summary: Referred the Tree Committee and Public Tree ordinances to the DPW Commissioner for feedback on operational authority and a formal estimate of the staffing costs required for implementation.

items.title: Private Tree Ordinance
items.summary: Referred the Private Tree ordinance to a working group consisting of councilors, the volunteer group Trees Medford, and the Building and Planning departments to simplify the draft and ensure it aligns with state zoning laws.
